name: html-cloud-mcp
description: Let Claude share the HTML it makes for you as a private, encrypted link. No account.
long_description: Adds a tool that turns HTML Claude generates — a page, report, presentation, or invitation — into a private share link. The HTML is encrypted with AES-256-GCM on your computer before anything is uploaded, so html.cloud stores only ciphertext it cannot read. No account, no public URL. Each share also returns a private edit link to replace, re-expire, or delete the page.

tools.name: share_html
tools.description: Share a self-contained HTML document as a private, encrypted link.
